1)先加入2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯、溶剂、催化剂、氢溴酸.en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione (环磺酮), comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.

除草剂环磺酮(Tembotrione)，化学名称：2-{2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3.en: The herbicide tembotrione (Tembotrione), chemical name: 2-{2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, is a triketone-class maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of nitrosulfone/mesotrione (硝磺酮) (mesotrione, methyl sulcotrione), and it is safe to the crop. Tembotrione is used mainly in maize fields; it is a post-emergence HPPD (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase) inhibitor herbicide, which can block the biosynthesis of prenyl (isoprenoid) quinones inside the plant, causing chlorosis, discoloration and tissue necrosis, and finally death within 2 weeks. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the mid-to-late post-emergence stage in maize fields, and it has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, hemp-nettle and cleavers, causes no phytotoxicity to the succeeding crop, and is one of the most important herbicides in United States maize fields, with a maximum application rate of 100 g/hm2 per season; the main formulation type is: oil dispersion (dispersible oil suspension concentrate). ... In 2007 tembotrione was first registered in Austria; the safener isoxadifen was added to the product, whose trade name is Laudis, for the control of grass weeds and broadleaf weeds in maize fields. In the same year the product was also registered in the United States and Hungary; in 2008 it was registered in Brazil; in 2009 it was registered in Portugal. In 2010 Capreno, the co-formulated product of tembotrione with thiencarbazone, was launched in the United States, and subsequently obtained further registrations in Europe and Latin America. ... Bayer's patent No. CN1323292A reports a process for synthesising tembotrione from 2,6-dichlorotoluene as the starting material; when preparing methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, NBS is used as the brominating agent, a large amount of solid waste is produced, and the yield is on the low side, only 67%. ... Volume 56, issue 5 of 《Nongyao》 (Pesticides) reported a synthesis process for the maize-field herbicide tembotrione. In synthesising methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, elemental bromine, which is comparatively hazardous, was used as the brominating agent; in synthesising 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, sodium methoxide was used as a raw material, and sodium methoxide is flammable, explosive and sensitive to air and moisture, decomposing rapidly on contact with water into methanol and sodium hydroxide, so the conditions for its use in an industrial process are demanding; in the synthesis of tembotrione acetonitrile was used, and acetonitrile belongs to the controlled, moderately toxic chemicals, and because it is extremely volatile it again in the production process readily causes chronic poisoning accidents.

除草剂环磺酮(Tembotrione)，化学名称：2-{2-氯-4-甲磺酰基-3.en: The herbicide tembotrione (Tembotrione), chemical name: 2-{2-chloro-4-methylsulfonyl-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoyl}cyclohexane-1,3-dione, is a triketone-class maize-field herbicide developed by Bayer in 2007; its activity is higher than that of nitrosulfone/mesotrione (硝磺酮) (mesotrione, methyl sulcotrione), and it is safe to the crop. Tembotrione is used mainly in maize fields; it is a post-emergence HPPD (4-hydroxyphenylpyruvate dioxygenase) inhibitor herbicide, which can block the biosynthesis of prenyl (isoprenoid) quinones inside the plant, causing chlorosis, discoloration and tissue necrosis, and finally death within 2 weeks. Tembotrione has a broad weed-control spectrum and a long window of application; its main targets are the various broadleaf weeds and grass weeds of the mid-to-late post-emergence stage in maize fields, and it has excellent efficacy against thistle, field bindweed, speedwell, gallant soldier, hemp-nettle and cleavers, causes no phytotoxicity to the succeeding crop, and is one of the most important herbicides in United States maize fields, with a maximum application rate of 100 g/hm2 per season; the main formulation type is: oil dispersion (dispersible oil suspension concentrate).

本发明公开一种除草剂环磺酮的合成工艺，包括：1)先加入2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺.en: Abstract. The present invention discloses a synthesis process for the herbicide tembotrione (环磺酮), comprising: 1) first charging methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate, a solvent, a catalyst and hydrobromic acid, then adding hydrogen peroxide dropwise; after the reaction, washing with water, concentrating and recrystallising to give the brominated compound methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate; 2) reacting the brominated compound, base 1, a catalyst, a solvent and 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol; after the reaction, filtering, washing with water and concentrating; adding base 2 and water, and after the reaction acidifying, filtering, washing and drying to give the etherified compound 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; 3) reacting the etherified compound, a catalyst, thionyl chloride and a solvent, then stripping off the solvent completely; adding 1,3-cyclohexanedione and a solvent, and adding triethylamine dropwise; after the reaction adding acetone cyanohydrin, washing with water, separating the layers, stripping the solvent completely from the oil layer, adding solvent to recrystallise, filtering and drying to give tembotrione as a rice-yellow (beige) solid. The present invention raises the yield of the intermediates, and is more environmentally friendly, safer and lower in production cost.
